title: Hⁿ-a.e. n-dimensional small-ball growth bound for a finite measure
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and let ν be a measure on ℝ^P = Eucl P with ν(ℝ^P) < ∞. Then for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ ℝ^P (Hⁿ = μHE[n]) there are C ∈ ℝ and r₀ > 0 with ν(B̄_r(x)) < ENNReal.ofReal(C·rⁿ) for every r ∈ (0, r₀), where B̄_r(x) = closedBall x r.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (ν : Measure (Eucl P)), ν univ < ∞ → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)), ∃ C r₀ : ℝ, 0 < r₀ ∧ ∀ r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) r₀, ν (closedBall x r) < ENNReal.ofReal (C * r ^ n)
